instructions: Every pair is presented to the router as a proposed From SUPPORTS To edge. expectedDecision and rationale must never enter the model prompt.

cases.from: A preregistered randomized trial found an 8 mmHg larger systolic-blood-pressure reduction than placebo in the studied population.
cases.to: The intervention lowers systolic blood pressure compared with placebo in the studied population.
cases.rationale: Direct controlled evidence supports the complete bounded claim.

cases.from: Five independent validation runs measured positioning error between 0.8% and 1.2%.
cases.to: The system remains below the specified 2% positioning-error threshold in the validation setup.
cases.rationale: The measurements substantively support the threshold conclusion.

cases.from: The audited statements report 2025 revenue of $4.2 billion.
cases.to: The company recorded $4.2 billion in revenue for 2025.
cases.rationale: The audited record is direct evidence for the complete factual claim.

cases.from: The ship's signed muster roll lists Elena Ruiz among the crew on 3 May 1912.
cases.to: Elena Ruiz served aboard the ship on 3 May 1912.
cases.rationale: The primary record directly supports the bounded historical claim.

cases.from: The frozen benchmark log records p95 latency of 84 ms under the specified 500-request-per-second workload.
cases.to: The service meets the p95-latency target of less than 100 ms under the specified workload.
cases.rationale: The logged measurement supports the full threshold claim under matching conditions.

cases.from: In the assay, treated cultures showed 62% lower enzyme activity than matched untreated controls.
cases.to: The treatment inhibits the enzyme in the stated assay conditions.
cases.rationale: The comparative assay result provides substantive evidence for inhibition.

cases.from: Orion 2 names the vendor's collection of model weights, inference code and training utilities.
cases.rationale: An identity definition does not establish the capability detail.

cases.from: The introduction says that the next section defines the spacing scale.
cases.to: The spacing scale contains 4, 8, 12, 16 and 24 pixel steps.
cases.rationale: An introduction does not support numerical details that appear only later.

cases.from: The policy permits research use and internal evaluation.
cases.to: The policy permits research use, internal evaluation and unrestricted commercial redistribution.
cases.rationale: From supports only part of To and does not establish unrestricted redistribution.

cases.from: The bridge satisfies the load requirement.
cases.to: Strain-gauge measurements remained below the specified limit throughout the load test.
cases.rationale: The conclusion does not serve as evidence for the underlying measurements; the support direction is reversed.
A shared value across different subjects provides no support.

cases.from: Atlas uses a capability-based security architecture.
cases.to: Atlas publishes official documentation in three languages.
cases.rationale: Same-product co-occurrence is not evidential support.
